description: This file defines a ShellExecutor utility within the OpenClaw project, providing functions to execute shell commands asynchronously with detailed result reporting, including handling of timeouts and process termination.

classes.name: ShellExecutor
classes.description: A utility object providing static methods to run shell commands asynchronously and handle their output with detailed status.

classes.name: ShellResult
classes.description: A struct representing the result of a shell command execution, including output, error message, and success status.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a shell command asynchronously with detailed result including exit status, timeout, and error handling.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a shell command asynchronously and returns a response object summarizing success, error message, and payload.
